description: Teaching parameters for the cost lessons, NOT price quotes. Values sit inside the all-in per-minute ranges that third-party teardowns of vendor pricing pages reported in October 2026 (see RESEARCH.md). Every total in Lessons 24, 25, and the capstone is computed by code from these stated parameters.
notes: Sum of per-minute components: 0.111 per minute before fixed per-call items, inside the roughly 0.09 to 0.15 all-in range reported for US inbound stacks.
